mapper.select:
SELECT code_seq, grp_cd, cd_nm, disp_ord, use_yn, del_yn, note, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at FROM utb_code_mst WHERE 1=1
AND (
grp_cd LIKE '%' || #{grpCd} || '%'
OR
cd_nm LIKE '%' || #{cdNm} || '%'
)
AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY disp_ord ASC, create_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO utb_code_mst ( code_seq, grp_cd, cd_nm, disp_ord, use_yn, del_yn, note, create_user, create_at ) VALUES ( fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_code_mst'::varchar), #{grpCd}, #{cdNm}, COALESCE(#{dispOrd}, 0), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{delYn}, 'N'), #{note}, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_code_mst SET cd_nm = #{cdNm}, use_yn = COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), del_yn = COALESCE(#{delYn}, del_yn), note = #{note}, disp_ord = COALESCE(#{dispOrd}, disp_ord), update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code_seq = #{codeSeq}
UPDATE utb_code_mst SET del_yn = 'Y', update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code_seq = #{codeSeq}
